en.headline: Italian gelato market runs at PMQ through the holiday weekend
en.dek: Ciao! Gelato Fest is at PMQ in Central from 1 to 4 October, with a second weekend listed for 9 to 11 October and free entry.
body: An Italian-style gelato market is open at PMQ in Central over the National Day holiday weekend. Organisers list Ciao! Gelato Fest for 1 to 4 October, and again from 9 to 11 October, at the ground-floor plaza and courtyard of PMQ, 35 Aberdeen Street.

The event listing gives opening hours of noon to 10pm and says entry is free. It describes about 20 gelato brands from Hong Kong, Macau, Italy and Portugal, with more than 30 flavours made for the market. Individual scoops are sold by the stalls. A separate tasting pass is also on sale; prices are set by the organisers.
The market opened on Thursday, the public holiday, and continues through Sunday. A second run is listed for the following weekend. PMQ is a short walk from Sheung Wan and Central stations.

The listing does not say that advance booking is required for entry. Visitors who want a particular flavour should expect stalls to sell out, as the organisers have described some flavours as limited to the event.

zh.headline: 意式雪糕市集假期在中環元創方舉行
zh.dek: 「Ciao! Gelato Fest」十月一日至四日在中環元創方舉行，主辦方另列十月九日至十一日為第二個週末，入場免費。
body: 國慶假期周末，中環元創方有意式雪糕市集。主辦方公布「Ciao! Gelato Fest」於十月一日至四日舉行，十月九日至十一日再辦一輪，地點是鴨巴甸街35號元創方地下廣場及中庭。
活動資料列明中午十二時至晚上十時開放，入場免費。市集匯集約二十個來自香港、澳門、意大利及葡萄牙的雪糕品牌，並有逾三十款為是次市集製作的口味。攤檔各自售賣雪糕，主辦方另設嘗味通行證，售價由主辦方訂定。
市集星期四公眾假期已開始，一直開到星期日，下一個周末再有一輪。元創方距離上環及中環站不遠，步行可達。
活動資料沒有寫明入場必須預先預約。主辦方形容部分口味為會場限定，個別口味售罄後或未能再買。
